senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. זָעַם)to be excited, troubled, serious.—Part. act. זוֹעֵף; f. זוֹעֶפֶת, pl. זוֹעֲפוֹת, part. pass. זָעוּף; f. זְעוּפָה; pl. זְעוּפוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite> <he>פנים זוע׳</he> (a. <he>זעו׳</he>) serious (commanding) countenance. Pesik. Baḥod. p. 110ᵃ; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 286:7">Yalk. Ex. 286</cite> <he>פנים זו׳</he>, contrad. to <he>בינוניות</he> indifferent, <he>מסבירות</he> inviting, kind countenance.
